notes: One lock per show. The file lock and the info lock are now one lock with three states, shown as one coloured badge on every card: Open (AniBox may change the show's info and files), Semi-locked (the saved info stays, new info waits in Review info, info files go to Plex after your check, files on the drive are never renamed or moved) and Locked (AniBox writes, changes and adds nothing). Change it on the show page, per library in Settings → Locks, or set a whole library in Settings → Libraries to show. Your old locks move over by themselves: shows AniBox had locked by itself become Semi-locked, shows you locked by hand become Locked and still get what's missing added, as before. Filter the library by lock under Filters.
